messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up team — we're running a short 'evidence triage' office-hours sprint for SOC2/ISO artifacts this week.
Ava (People Ops): Drop-in times: Tue 10:00–12:00 PT, Wed 15:00–17:00 PT, Thu 09:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invites: https://cal.example/ri/evidence-sprint :calendar:
Sam (Security): I'll be on Tue and Thu. Please flag any items that need redaction or CII handling before upload.
Marta (Legal): Reminder: PDFs must have access logs and retention statements attached. If you're unsure, ask in the session.
Nate (Eng): Quick q — preferred filename pattern for logs? We have bulk zips.
Sam (Security): filename pattern: service_component_YYYYMMDD.log(.gz ok). For bulk zips, include a manifest.txt listing contents.
Ava (People Ops): Upload path: https://evidence.redwood.internal/upload — set tag 'SOC2-Q2' or 'ISO-9001'. If you can't upload, DM me and we'll arrange SFTP.
Compliance Bot: New event created: "Evidence Triage — Tue 10am PT". Attendee count: 12.
Ava (People Ops): Cutoff for collection is Fri EOD PT. After that, we'll start packaging artifacts for the auditor. If you think your team needs more time, ping me before Thu EOD.
Nate (Eng): Noted. I'll bring a short manifest generator script to the Wed session.
Marta (Legal): Thanks, team. Please avoid sharing customer PII unless it's been redacted or consented — follow the redaction checklist in Confluence.
Sam (Security): If you need help with redaction tools, drop a message here or add a ticket to sec-ops.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks — we'll post a short recap + action items after the last session. :sparkles:
